categories.main_business_segments: Legend Holdings operates primarily through two sectors: diversified-industries operation and industrial incubations and investments. The diversified-industries operation includes Lenovo (intelligent devices and infrastructure), Levima Group (advanced materials R&D and production), Joyvio Group (modern agriculture and food), and BIL (banking services). The industrial incubations and investments segment focuses on venture capital, private equity, early-stage investments in technology startups, and investments in aviation logistics, financial services, healthcare, and office leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), hybrid AI computing, and proprietary manufacturing processes. Lenovo leads in AI PCs, servers with liquid cooling technology, and AI infrastructure. Levima Group focuses on advanced materials including EVA photovoltaic adhesive films, biodegradable plastics, lithium-ion battery materials, and electronic specialty gases, employing proprietary continuous processing technologies and molecular biology platforms. The company also invests heavily in R&D with a record RMB 15.8 billion spent in 2024.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Legend Holdings serves a broad range of customers including individual consumers and enterprises for Lenovo’s products, financial institutions and retail clients for BIL, agricultural product buyers and food industry clients for Joyvio Group, and industrial clients for Levima Group’s advanced materials. Its markets span technology, agriculture, finance, healthcare, and industrial sectors, with a focus on China and global markets including Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific, and emerging regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China, Europe, Americas, and Asia-Pacific regions. Lenovo has a global market share leadership in PCs and smartphones, BIL operates primarily in Luxembourg and Europe, Joyvio Group has operations in China, Australia, and Chile, and Levima Group serves markets in China and exports to 21 countries. The company’s revenue distribution is roughly balanced across China, Asia-Pacific (excluding China), Europe/Middle East/Africa, and Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Legend Holdings operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. Lenovo manufactures and sells end-user intelligent devices and infrastructure, Levima Group produces advanced materials used in manufacturing, Joyvio Group manages agricultural production and food supply chains, and BIL provides financial services. The company also invests upstream in technology startups and industrial innovations through its incubations and investments segment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven development, particularly in AI, new energy materials, biotechnology, and advanced manufacturing. It emphasizes building a full AI stack ecosystem, expanding AI-enabled products and services, and advancing green and low-carbon technologies. R&D initiatives include development of AI PCs, hybrid AI infrastructure, new energy battery materials, biodegradable plastics, and electronic specialty gases, supported by national key R&D programs and substantial patent filings.
categories.revenue_model: Legend Holdings generates revenue through product sales (Lenovo’s devices, Levima’s materials, Joyvio’s agricultural products), service fees (BIL’s banking and financial services, Lakala’s digital payment services), investment income from portfolio companies, and leasing income from properties. The company also earns revenue from technology licensing, digital solutions, and financial leasing services. Revenue recognition includes both point-in-time sales and over-time service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lenovo is positioned as the global leader in PC manufacturing with a 24.3% market share, ahead of competitors by nearly five percentage points. Levima Group is a leading player in advanced materials in China with strong market share and technological advantages. Joyvio Group is a top fruit and seafood supplier in China and internationally. BIL is among the top three banks in Luxembourg with high credit ratings. The company maintains competitive advantages through innovation, diversified portfolios, and strategic investments in emerging technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Legend Holdings reported revenue of RMB 512.8 billion in 2024, an 18% increase year-on-year, and achieved a net profit attributable to equity holders of RMB 133 million, turning from loss to profit. Lenovo contributed significantly with RMB 468.9 billion revenue and 74% net profit growth. The company’s total assets reached approximately RMB 696 billion. The industrial incubations and investments segment reduced losses substantially. The company maintains a diversified and resilient growth profile with strong investment capabilities and expanding global footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Legend Holdings emphasizes technological innovation, diversified industry presence, and strategic investments to create new quality productive forces aligned with China’s national priorities. Lenovo differentiates through AI-enabled intelligent devices and infrastructure with proprietary technologies like liquid cooling and AI agents. Levima Group offers high-value advanced materials with integrated industrial chains and green technologies. Joyvio Group provides fully digitalized, globalized agricultural supply chains. The company’s comprehensive AI ecosystem and commitment to ESG principles further enhance its competitive differentiation.
